summaries.title: Seed-TTS: A Family of High-Quality Versatile Speech Generation Models
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Seed-TTS** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖上下文学习（In-Context Learning (ICL)），并引入 additionally present a non-autoregressive (NAR) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：We introduce Seed-TTS, a family of large-scale autoregressive text-to-speech (TTS) models capable of generating speech that is virtually indistinguishable from human speech。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用强化学习策略优化与奖励驱动对齐、师生知识蒸馏与能力迁移、迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：With fine-tuning, we achieve even higher subjective scores across these metrics。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We demonstrate that this variant achieves comparable performance to the language model-based variant and showcase its effectiveness in speech editing）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 38 赞），本工作为突破 **合成数据与精细化配比 (Data Curation)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Self-Improving Robust Preference Optimization
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「跨域/跨本体分布外泛化受限、安全对齐脆弱性、隐私版权与潜在失控风险」痛点，作者围绕 **Self-Improving Robust Preference Optimization** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖基于人类反馈的强化学习（Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF)）、直接偏好优化（Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)）、分布外泛化（Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Generalization），并引入 SRPO in terms of AI Win-Rate (WR) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：Despite their success, the existing methods suffer from a fundamental problem that their optimal solution is highly task-dependent (i.e., not robust to out-of-distribution...。

summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **CamCo** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖扩散模型（Diffusion Model）。核心论点主张：To address this issue, we introduce CamCo, which allows fine-grained Camera pose Control for image-to-video generation。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Additionally, we fine-tune CamCo on real-world videos with camera poses estimated through structure-from-motion algorithms to better synthesize object motion。
